correctness.rationale: From ef(x)=fe(x)=f(ρ_i) for x in B_i, a root must go to a root, and all of its block must land in the corresponding target block. Conversely these conditions give commutation and determine a unique root map g. For each hit target block the root is already an image point, and its M_j nonroot inputs are independently assigned. Choosing h nonroot targets and requiring each hit, with the root optional for these inputs, gives the displayed inclusion-exclusion factor W; separate target blocks contribute disjoint images. For idempotents, g is idempotent, so a hit target block lies in its own preimage and M_j≥b_j−1. Mark h nonroot image points and fix them; then all other M_j−h inputs go to any of the h+1 chosen image points. This is exactly V and fixes the entire image, hence is sufficient for idempotence. For rank one the only images are single roots. The rank-two cases are two roots, giving a surjection on the roots (or fixing the two targets for idempotents), or one root plus a nonroot of the same block. In the latter there are N choices of nonroot over all roots, and 2^N−1 allowed nonroot assignments (2^{N−1} after fixing it for idempotents). This proves both low-rank formulas including r=1 and N=0 with the stated conventions. Direct independent enumeration checks eight profiles, including both quoted profiles and low-rank degenerate cases. It confirms the profile-sensitive rank-three contrasts 108 vs 78 and 31 vs 19.
residual_risks: The replay exhausts all maps at the listed profiles, not arbitrary n. Arbitrary unequal sizes are covered by the block decomposition and image counting proof.

value.rationale: The polynomials provide a natural image-size invariant for all elements and all retractions in a standard transformation monoid with arbitrary unequal kernel blocks. They explain exactly why the two smallest positive strata do not distinguish profiles and exhibit the first possible distinction. This is useful beyond the already-known characterization of which maps commute, and does not require exhaustive listing of n^n transformations to obtain exact coefficients.
residual_risks: The sum over root maps need not be computationally optimal, and profile differences at rank three are possible, not universal.
